title: Construction and Real Estate Development Consulting Services

hero.subtitle: PH&C facilitates Real Estate Development as the tri-state area’s premiere Owner’s Representation, Construction Management, Land Development and Fee Development firm.

contentCards.title: Our Team
contentCards.content:
PH\&C is a construction management firm that works on the owner’s side of the table. We are your advisor, not your contractor, and we bring independent judgment to every phase of a project, from early due diligence through design, procurement, construction, and closeout.

Construction is where budgets, schedules, and reputations are won or lost. Our job is to make sure the decisions that shape your project are informed ones. We review the documents, test the assumptions, track the numbers, and tell you plainly what we see, so you can act with confidence.

Owners, lenders, and investors rely on us because our only stake in the outcome is theirs. We don’t build the project, so we never have to defend how it’s being built. That independence lets us ask the hard questions early, while the answers are still affordable.

Every engagement is handled with discretion. Our clients trust us with sensitive information, and we protect it accordingly.

Whether you’re evaluating an acquisition, planning a new build, or need an experienced voice on a project already underway, PH\&C gives you clarity, accountability, and an advocate focused entirely on your interests.

contentCards.title: Project Planning & Coordination
contentCards.content: Great projects are won before ground breaks. Our team maps scope, budget, schedule, and approvals up front, so you move forward with a clear plan and no surprises. From feasibility and site analysis to permitting strategy and procurement, we align every stakeholder around one path to delivery.
If you're ready to learn more, reach out to us today and we can assess how we can help with your next construction project.
